tools.name: Brush
tools.description: A fine-bristled brush for clearing loose soil. Gives you an extra strike at every dig site.

tools.name: Iron Spade
tools.description: A sturdy spade that can break through compacted earth. Gives two extra strikes at every dig site.

tools.name: Loadstone Rod
tools.description: A divining rod attuned to buried relics. Reveals all tiles adjacent to any tile you strike.

tools.name: Seer's Lens
tools.description: A ground lens that catches a glint from valuable deposits. Lowers the headline threshold by 1 at every dig site.
